user.title: Connect TSAWaitTimes.com airport
user.description: The nearest unconfigured airport with known coordinates is preselected using Home Assistant’s location, calculated locally without sending your coordinates. Confirm it or choose any airport from the live directory. If no default is available, choose manually. No account or API key required. Estimates are modeled, not measured queue times.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to read TSAWaitTimes.com. Wait at least five minutes before retrying (up to one hour after rate limiting).
error.invalid_input: Select a directory airport and whole minutes from 5 to 1440.
